errors.text_span: докато Южна и Източна Европа се появяват като категории едва от 2010 г. насам
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect and misleading. Southern Europe (Южна Европа) first has a non-zero value in 2010, but Eastern Europe (Източна Европа) first has a non-zero value in 2018. The statement incorrectly groups them as both appearing from 2010.

errors.text_span: През 2012 г. се наблюдава първото появяване на стойности за Южна Европа (1)
errors.evidence: The chart shows that the first non-zero value for Southern Europe (Южна Европа) is 1, but this occurs in the year 2010, not 2012. In 2012, the value is also 1, but it is not the first appearance.

errors.text_span: а през 2016 г. — за Източна Европа (3)
errors.evidence: The chart shows that the first non-zero value for Eastern Europe (Източна Европа) is 3, but this occurs in the year 2018, not 2016. In 2016, the value for Eastern Europe is 0.
